statement: Commercial traffic through the Strait of Hormuz is halted for more than 24 consecutive hours at some point between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if Reuters or Lloyds List Intelligence and Iranian state media both report a halt of commercial Hormuz transits exceeding 24 consecutive hours occurring between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: MISS if no continuous halt of commercial Hormuz transits exceeding 24 hours occurs inside the event window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A Ukrainian strike damages a named Russian oil refinery between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-06, notwithstanding US pressure to stop refinery strikes.
resolution: TRUE if a Russian federal or regional official confirms a strike on a named refinery dated between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-06, and Reuters or AFP reports the same strike.
failure_condition: MISS if no strike on a named Russian refinery inside the window is confirmed by both a Russian official and a major wire service.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: ICE front-month Brent settles at or above 120.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-30. Reference: 108.29 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the official ICE Brent front-month settlement price is 120.00 USD or higher on any trading day from 2026-09-15 through 2026-10-30. Reference level 108.29 at seal.
failure_condition: MISS if every ICE Brent front-month settlement inside the window prints below 120.00 USD.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The FRED series DGS10 records a value of 5.50 percent or higher on at least one business day between 2026-09-15 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 4.99 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any FRED DGS10 observation dated 2026-09-15 through 2026-12-31 is 5.50 or greater. Reference level 4.99 percent at seal.
failure_condition: MISS if the highest DGS10 observation inside the window is below 5.50.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Anthropic publicly files a Form S-1 registration statement with the SEC, visible on EDGAR, with a filing date between 2026-09-15 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if EDGAR full-text search returns a Form S-1 or S-1/A filed by Anthropic with a filing date between 2026-09-15 and 2026-12-31. Confidential submissions not yet public do not count.
failure_condition: MISS if no public Anthropic S-1 exists on EDGAR with a filing date inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog carries at least one entry with vendorProject GitLab and a dateAdded value between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities JSON contains a GitLab entry whose dateAdded falls between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-16 inclusive.
failure_condition: MISS if no GitLab entry in the KEV catalog carries a dateAdded inside that range.

statement: Microsoft resolves the September 2026 Windows Server RDS connection failure with a shipped update between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if the Windows release health entry for the September 2026 RDS failure shows status Resolved by an out-of-band update, Known Issue Rollback, or cumulative update dated between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-16.
failure_condition: MISS if the RDS regression is not fixed by a shipped Microsoft update inside the window.

statement: A US Senate roll call on the CLARITY Act or a motion directly on it is held between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-18 and records fewer than 60 yea votes.
resolution: TRUE if Senate.gov roll call records show a vote on the CLARITY Act or a related cloture or passage motion between 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-18 with fewer than 60 yeas.
failure_condition: MISS if no such roll call occurs inside the window, or if the yea count reaches 60 or more.

resolution: TRUE if the Riksdag voting record at riksdagen.se shows a prime minister vote held between 2026-09-21 and 2026-12-11 in which Magdalena Andersson is elected.
failure_condition: MISS if no Riksdag vote inside the window elects Andersson Prime Minister, including a vote that elects anyone else.

failure_condition: MISS if the GDACS alert level for that cyclone never exceeds green inside the window.
